## Core Product Categories

Primary high-level categories and industry verticals available across the platform:

- **Accessories** - Jewelry, watches, sunglasses, belts, and complementary fashion items.
- **Branded Textile** - Premium apparel, designer clothing, and licensed textile brands.
- **Consumer Electronic** - Smartphones, computers, tablets, gaming consoles, and personal tech accessories.
- **Cosmetics** - Makeup, skincare, haircare, perfumes, and personal care products.
- **FMCG** - Fast-moving consumer goods, groceries, household supplies, and daily essentials.
- **Furniture** - Living room, bedroom, office, and outdoor furniture pieces.
- **GAS** - Global Apparel Sourcing / General Apparel Stock (Fashion basics, casual wear, and core apparel lines).
- **GM** - General Merchandise (Home decor, kitchenware, toys, hobby items, and stationery).
- **Home Electronics** - Major appliances, white goods, television sets, and smart home systems.
- **Home** - Home textiles, bedding, towels, curtains, and interior styling products.
- **Shoes and Bags** - Footwear for all ages, athletic shoes, handbags, backpacks, and luggage.

## Language and Regional Variants

# Trendyol E-Commerce Platform

> Founded in 2010, Trendyol is the leading e-commerce platform in Türkiye and one of the top platforms in the world. Supported by cutting-edge technology, Trendyol's multi-category marketplace connects over 250,000 predominantly Turkish sellers, global brands, and its own-brand Trendyol Collection with more than 40 million customers on dedicated local language apps. Trendyol is the leading e-commerce platform in Türkiye, Romania, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates, and is widely known as the first choice for online shopping.

Known for its wide selection of fashion, electronics, beauty, and home products, Trendyol provides a seamless shopping experience for its customers. In Türkiye, Trendyol's local app also provides access to food and grocery deliveries via Trendyol Go, and second-hand clothing via Dolap.

In 2022, Trendyol became the first Turkish e-commerce business to launch a sustainable impact plan. Alongside a wide range of activities including carbon impact, product safety, chemical compliance, waste management, sustainable materials, traceable production, and workers' rights, the company runs programmes that promote women's empowerment, entrepreneurship, digitalization (particularly in remote areas of the country), and the work of local artists and museums.

This file highlights selected resources to help language models extract structured knowledge, understand Trendyol's taxonomy, and navigate the content ecosystem efficiently.

## Subbrands and Services

Core ecosystem services and brands operating under Trendyol Group:

- [TrendyolMilla](https://www.trendyol-milla.com) - In-house fashion brand translating the latest runway trends into wearable outfits for every style, occasion, and price point.
- [Trendyol Go](https://tgoyemek.com/) - Instant meal and grocery delivery service integrated within Trendyol's ecosystem in Türkiye.
- [Dolap](https://dolap.com/) - One of the largest second-hand marketplace platforms in Türkiye, enabling users to contribute to the circular economy.

## Old Sites and Services
- [m.trendyol] - m.trendyol is the old mobile domain and is no longer in use.
